meta.parties: Alagiawanna Gurunnanse v. Don Hendrick Et Al

rules.statement: A lessee cannot sue his lessor for breach of implied warranty of title in a Court of Requests or District Court unless the lessor has ousted the lessee from possession.
rules.supporting_quote: "I agree, " he said, "in .the view expressed by Layard C.J. and Moncreiff J. in Fernando v. Fernando, 2 that the claim against the lessor does not affect the alleged trespasser, and cannot be put forward in the action against him."
